# Combining the FreeSurfer output tables
The FreeSurfer output for ABIDE II was not complete, so I had to add some of the missing sites 

```{r packages}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
```

## 1) aseg tables: add the U_MIA site
```{r add-mia-aseg, eval = FALSE}
# The MIA and USM FreeSurfer outputs were later moved into OutputFreeSurfer/FreeSurferUSM+UM,
# and their aseg tables to OutputFreeSurfer/ (aseg_volume_tableUM.txt, aseg_volume_USM.csv).
# The paths below point to these current locations.

mia  <- read_delim('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/OutputFreeSurfer/aseg_volume_tableUM.txt',
delim = "\t", col_types = cols())
otherSitesABIDE2 <- read_delim('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/OutputFreeSurfer/ABIDE2/aseg_stats.txt',  delim = "\t", col_types = cols())

# asegstats2table names the first column "Measure:volume" -> rename to SUB_ID in both tables
mia <- mia %>%
  rename(SUB_ID = 1) %>%
  mutate(SUB_ID = sub("^UM_", "", SUB_ID))  # MIA subjects were prefixed "UM_"

otherSitesABIDE2 <- otherSitesABIDE2 %>%
  rename(SUB_ID = 1) %>%
  mutate(SUB_ID = as.character(SUB_ID))

# Keep only the columns present in both tables
common_cols <- intersect(names(otherSitesABIDE2), names(mia))

combined <- bind_rows(
  otherSitesABIDE2 %>% select(all_of(common_cols)),
  mia              %>% select(all_of(common_cols))
)

# Written to the working directory, then moved to Data/OutputFreeSurfer/ABIDE2/
# write_csv(combined, "aseg_volume_table_ALLSITES_combined.csv")
```

## 2) aseg tables: add the USM site
```{r add-usm-aseg, eval = FALSE}
usm <- read_csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/OutputFreeSurfer/aseg_volume_USM.csv')
otherSitesABIDE2 <- read_csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/OutputFreeSurfer/ABIDE2/aseg_volume_table_ALLSITES_combined.csv')  # output of chunk 1

usm <- usm %>%
  rename(SUB_ID = 1) %>%
  mutate(SUB_ID = sub("^USM_", "", SUB_ID))

otherSitesABIDE2 <- otherSitesABIDE2 %>%
  rename(SUB_ID = 1) %>%
  mutate(SUB_ID = as.character(SUB_ID))

common_cols <- intersect(names(otherSitesABIDE2), names(usm))

combined <- bind_rows(
  otherSitesABIDE2 %>% select(all_of(common_cols)),
  usm              %>% select(all_of(common_cols))
)

# Final ABIDE II aseg table, used in step 4 of the QC script
# write_csv(combined,"/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/OutputFreeSurfer/ABIDE2/aseg_volume_table_ALLSITES_combined_final.csv")
```

## 3) Stats2Table output for Qoala-T: combine all sites and both datasets
```{r combine-qoala-input, eval = FALSE}
ABIDE1 <- read_csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/FreeSurfer/FreeSurfer_Output_ABIDE1.csv')
ABIDE2 <- read_csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/FreeSurfer/FreeSurfer_Output_ABIDE2.csv')
usm    <- read_csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/FreeSurfer/FreeSurfer_Output_ABIDE2USM.csv')
mia    <- read_csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/FreeSurfer/FreeSurfer_Output_ABIDE2MIA.csv')

# Harmonise the subject ID column
ABIDE1 <- ABIDE1 %>% rename(SUB_ID = `...1`) %>% mutate(SUB_ID = as.character(SUB_ID))
ABIDE2 <- ABIDE2 %>% rename(SUB_ID = `...1`) %>% mutate(SUB_ID = as.character(SUB_ID))
usm    <- usm    %>% rename(SUB_ID = 1)      %>% mutate(SUB_ID = sub("^USM_", "", SUB_ID))
mia    <- mia    %>% rename(SUB_ID = 1)      %>% mutate(SUB_ID = sub("^UM_",  "", SUB_ID))

# Keep only the columns present in all ABIDE II tables
common_cols <- Reduce(intersect, list(colnames(ABIDE2), colnames(usm), colnames(mia)))

ABIDE2_all <- bind_rows(
  ABIDE2 %>% select(all_of(common_cols)),
  usm    %>% select(all_of(common_cols)),
  mia    %>% select(all_of(common_cols))
)

# sanity check: rows of ABIDE2_all = sum of the three tables
dim(ABIDE2); dim(usm); dim(mia); dim(ABIDE2_all)

# Exclude the ABIDE II longitudinal subjects (same IDs as in the QC script, step 1)
exclude_ID_long <- c(50002, 50005, 50006, 50007, 50013, 50026, 50027,
                     50028, 50029, 50031, 50035, 50038, 50047,
                     50048, 50049, 50050, 50051)

ABIDE2_all <- ABIDE2_all %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% exclude_ID_long)

# Combine ABIDE II and ABIDE I
ABIDE_all <- bind_rows(
  ABIDE2_all %>% select(all_of(common_cols)),
  ABIDE1     %>% select(all_of(common_cols))
)

# write.csv(ABIDE2_all, '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/FreeSurfer/FreeSurfer_Output_ABIDE2_all.csv')

# write.csv(ABIDE_all,  '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/FreeSurfer/FreeSurfer_Output_ABIDE.csv')  # input for Qoala-T (step 5)
```
